relations.subject: Anthony Kennedy Warder
relations.object: School of Oriental and African Studies
relations.evidence: He studied Sanskrit and Pali at the School of Oriental and African Studies, and received his doctorate from there in 1954.

relations.subject: Anthony Kennedy Warder
relations.place: School of Oriental and African Studies
relations.evidence: His thesis, supervised by John Brough, was entitled Pali Metre: A Study of the Evolution of Early Middle Indian Metre Based on the Verse Preserved in the Pali Canon.

relations.subject: Anthony Kennedy Warder
relations.evidence: His began his academic career at the University of Edinburgh in 1955, but in 1963 moved to the University of Toronto.

relations.subject: Anthony Kennedy Warder
relations.role: Chairman of the Department of East Asian Studies
relations.evidence: but in 1963 moved to the University of Toronto. There, as Chairman of the Department of East Asian Studies, he built up a strong programme in Sanskrit and South Asian studies. He retired in 1990.

relations.subject: Narendra K. Wagle
relations.evidence: Studies on Buddhism in Honour of Professor A. K. Warder was published in 1993, edited by Narendra K. Wagle and Fumimaro Watanabe.
